sourceRule: One original Sheet ID per project/subject if maintained as Sheet; CAD/verified measurement export owns geometry

sections.title: Measurement Book / QTO
sections.grain: one measured instance or line per evidence-backed element/location and revision

sections.title: Bill of Quantities
sections.grain: group measured rows by work-item + unit + approved rate selection + scope
sections.formula: SUM(verified eligible measured quantities) × approved unit rate

sections.title: Abstract of Cost
sections.grain: summarize approved BOQ groups, with distinct allowances, contingency, taxes and exclusions
sections.formula: SUM(approved BOQ group amounts) + authorized allowances + contingency + applicable taxes

billingExtensions.title: Contractor Running Account Bills
billingExtensions.grain: one contractor/project/contract period and cumulative certified quantity per line
billingExtensions.authority: Certified measurement book + signed contract + previous certificates

billingExtensions.title: Vendor Invoices
billingExtensions.grain: one invoice with separate item/receipt/PO matching
billingExtensions.authority: Original vendor invoice + purchase order + delivery receipt

billingExtensions.title: Actual Payments
billingExtensions.grain: one payment transaction allocated to verified invoice or contractor certificate

rules: A rate alternative is not a measured quantity
Do not use zero for missing quantities, bills or money
Do not combine turnkey with covered trade components
Do not combine labour-only and inclusive alternatives
Previous certified cumulative quantities must not exceed current cumulative
Claimed is not certified; certified is not paid
Every derived row must preserve source IDs, method, revision and approval state
Public Pages contains only approved sanitized projections, never credentials or private attachments
